how: Reviewer-recorded on DGX Spark (Linux aarch64) as the dedicated test user zylos-test with a temporary HOME, in the same session as the input screens (Gemini API key mode, AGY_CLI_DISABLE_AUTO_UPDATE=true, private tmux socket, pane 200x50). The statusLine command copied its stdin unmodified to a new file on every invocation; each sample is one of those files, chosen by the state shown on screen at that moment, without the Zylos statusLine wrapper. Captured between 16:30:04Z and 16:33:43Z.

files.idle.json: Idle after a completed turn: no task_count and no subagents.
files.background-task.json: A background shell task (sleep) running while the main agent is idle: task_count 1.
files.running-subagent.json: A subagent running a foreground sleep: subagents[0].status running.
files.after-escape.json: After Esc interrupted the subagent turn: subagents[0].status completed, no running work.
